schemes.fund_type: Open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid cap stocks

lock_in_period.description: Nil. This is an open-ended equity fund with no statutory lock-in period.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 0.74% (inclusive of GST).

exit_load.description: An exit load of 1.00% is applicable for units redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment. No exit load is payable for units redeemed after 1 year.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment amount is ₹100 per installment. The minimum lump sum investment amount for initial as well as additional purchases is ₹100.

taxation.short_term_capital_gains: STCG is taxed at 20% if redeemed within 12 months.
taxation.long_term_capital_gains: LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh in a financial year is taxed at 12.5% without indexation if held for more than 12 months.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Account statements and capital gains reports can be downloaded online from the Groww App under Profile > Reports or directly via the HDFC MF online investor portal using your PAN and Folio number.
operations.folio_lookup: Check registered folio numbers in your Groww mutual funds dashboard or consolidated account statement (CAS).

schemes.fund_type: Open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in small cap stocks

lock_in_period.description: Nil. This is an open-ended equity fund with no statutory lock-in period.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Small Cap Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 0.68% (inclusive of GST).

exit_load.description: An exit load of 1.00% is charged if units are redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from allotment. Nil exit load after 1 year.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment is ₹100 per installment. The minimum lump sum purchase amount is ₹100 for both initial and additional purchases.

taxation.short_term_capital_gains: STCG is taxed at 20% if redeemed within 12 months.
taxation.long_term_capital_gains: LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year is taxed at 12.5% without indexation if held for more than 12 months.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Investors can generate consolidated or scheme-specific account statements from the Groww App (Profile > Reports > Mutual Fund Statements) or via the HDFC MF portal.
operations.folio_lookup: Registered folio details can be verified in the Groww dashboard or via CAMS/KFintech CAS statements.

schemes.scheme_name: HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund
schemes.fund_type: Open-ended Fund of Fund scheme investing in units of HDFC Gold Exchange Traded Fund (ETF)

lock_in_period.description: Nil. There is no statutory lock-in period for this fund of funds scheme.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 0.25% (investors also bear the underlying ETF scheme expenses).

exit_load.description: An exit load of 1.00% is applicable if units are redeemed or switched out on or before 15 days from the date of allotment. No exit load is payable if redeemed after 15 days.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment is ₹100 per installment. The minimum lump sum investment amount is ₹100 for initial as well as additional purchases.

taxation.tax_regime: Specified Mutual Fund / Debt & Commodities Taxation rules as per applicable Finance Act provisions based on holding duration and investor tax slab.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Download statements via Groww Profile > Reports > Mutual Funds or through HDFC AMC / CAMS online facilities.
operations.folio_lookup: Accessible in your Groww portfolio and consolidated account statements (CAS).

schemes.fund_type: Open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in large cap stocks

lock_in_period.description: Nil. This open-ended equity fund carries no statutory lock-in period.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Top 100 Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 1.08%.

exit_load.description: An exit load of 1.00% is levied if units are redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from allotment. Nil exit load after 1 year.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment is ₹100 per installment. The minimum initial and additional lump sum investment is ₹100.

taxation.short_term_capital_gains: STCG is taxed at 20% if redeemed within 12 months.
taxation.long_term_capital_gains: LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year is taxed at 12.5% without indexation if held for more than 12 months.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Obtain account and tax statements online through Groww (Reports section) or by visiting the HDFC Mutual Fund investor service portal.
operations.folio_lookup: Viewable in the Groww dashboard under Holdings or on the CAMS/KFintech CAS statement.

schemes.fund_type: An open-ended equity linked saving scheme with a statutory lock-in of 3 years and tax benefit under Section 80C

lock_in_period.description: Mandatory 3-year (36 months) lock-in period from the date of allotment for each installment. Units cannot be redeemed, transferred, or switched out during the lock-in period.

expense_ratio.description: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 1.09%.

exit_load.description: Nil. No exit load is charged for redemption after the completion of the statutory 3-year lock-in period.

investment_limits.description: The minimum SIP investment is ₹500 and in multiples of ₹500. The minimum lump sum investment amount is ₹500 for initial as well as additional purchases.

taxation.tax_deduction: Investments qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act up to ₹1.5 Lakh per financial year.
taxation.short_term_capital_gains: Not applicable as redemption is locked for 3 years.
taxation.long_term_capital_gains: LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year upon redemption after 3 years is taxed at 12.5% without indexation.

operations.account_statement_procedure: Tax saving investment certificates (80C proofs) and account statements can be downloaded via Groww Profile > Reports > Capital Gains & Tax Reports or via HDFC MF website.
operations.folio_lookup: Check registered folio in Groww dashboard or monthly consolidated account statements (CAS).

general_operations.entity_name: General Mutual Fund Operations & Account Services

statement_download.groww_procedure: To download mutual fund statements on Groww: Open Groww App > Tap Profile Icon > Select 'Reports' > Choose 'Mutual Fund Statements' or 'Capital Gains Report' > Select Financial Year and email or download PDF.
statement_download.amc_procedure: To download statements from HDFC Mutual Fund directly: Visit the official HDFC AMC portal > Navigate to 'Investor Services' > Enter PAN / Folio Number > Authenticate via registered email/mobile OTP > Download Account / Capital Gains Statement.
statement_download.cas_procedure: Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) can also be downloaded from CAMS (camsonline.com) or KFintech (kfintech.com) using your registered email and PAN.

capital_gains_report.purpose: Used for Income Tax Return (ITR) filing to report Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG) and Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG).
capital_gains_report.download_steps: Groww App > Profile > Reports > Capital Gains Report > Select Assessment Year > Download Schedule 112A Excel/PDF.
